correctness.rationale: Fresh differentiation of the frozen cubic reproduces the exhaustive branch split: when \(x_{13}=0\), the remaining gradient equations force \(x_{12}=x_{23}=0\); when \(x_{13}\ne0\), they force \(x_{12}=x_{23}=0\), \(x_{11}=x_{33}\), and \(x_{22}=x_{33}+x_{13}\). Pavlov supplies primality and dimension five. The singular locus has dimension three, hence codimension two; the hypersurface is Cohen--Macaulay, so Serre \(S_2+R_1\) gives normality. A fresh symbolic replay reproduced the rank-four Hessian certificate on the secondary plane and the diagonal normal-slice kernel with cubic coefficient \((a-b)(b-c)(a-c)\), giving the stated \(A_1\) and \(A_2\) types by the splitting lemma.
correctness.risk: The lower-dimensional collision strata inside the diagonal plane, including the scalar line, are intentionally unclassified.

final_claim: For Pavlov's colored 3-chain Gibbs cubic over \(\mathbb C\), the reduced singular locus is the union of the diagonal three-plane and the stated secondary two-plane; the hypersurface is normal, with generic transverse type \(A_2\) on the pairwise-distinct diagonal stratum and transverse type \(A_1\) on the secondary plane away from the diagonal.
limitations: The \(A_2\) statement assumes pairwise-distinct diagonal entries.
